1.title: Google Cloud AI Solutions
1.text: Welcome to Module seven: Google Cloud A I Solutions. It covers the exam area three. Innovating with Google Cloud artificial intelligence. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do seven things. three point two Explain how Google Cloud's A I offerings can create business value: the strategic considerations when selecting A I solutions. The functionality of Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and its business use cases. Matching pre-trained A P Is and foundation models to use cases. Building custom models with your own data. The core components of A I Hypercomputer. Big Query M L. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: three. Innovating with Google Cloud artificial intelligence (about eighteen percent). Exam format: ninety minutes and fifty to sixty multiple-choice questions. Validated against: the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide.

1.title: Choosing an AI solution
1.text: Choosing an A I solution. The figure shows this: The ladder of Google Cloud A I choices from ready-made to fully custom.

1.title: Choosing an AI solution, continued
1.text: Choosing an A I solution. Implementation speed. How fast must it be live? Development effort. How much work can we invest? Business differentiation. Must it be unique to us, or is standard enough? Technical expertise. Do we have data scientists and engineers? Choice and flexibility. Do we need many models and tools, with no lock-in? The trade-off: ready-made equals fastest, least effort, least differentiation. Custom equals most effort and expertise, most differentiation.

1.title: Choosing an AI solution, continued
1.text: Choosing an A I solution. Pre-trained A P Is and foundation models. A common task (translate, transcribe, see, write) and you want speed. Auto M L (train on your data, little code). Your data and labels, limited M L expertise. Custom models. Unique needs and strong M L skills. Exam tip: Speed and low effort to pre-trained. Own data, low expertise to Auto M L. Unique advantage, high expertise to custom.

1.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
1.text: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (often just Agent Platform; it is the Google Cloud A I developer platform earlier named Vertex A I) is the open, all-in-one platform for technical teams to build, scale, govern and optimize enterprise-grade A I agents and applications grounded in company data.

1.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, continued
1.text: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Model Garden. two hundred plus models: Google's Gemini, partner and open models. Agent Studio. Build and customize agents and generative A I apps with Gemini. Auto M L. Train custom models on your data with little code. Custom training and notebooks. Your own models with frameworks like Tensor Flow and Py Torch; notebooks integrated with Big Query. M L Ops. Model Registry, Pipelines, Model Evaluation, Feature Store, monitoring for drift. Governance. Register, manage and secure the agents of the organization. Gemini Enterprise is the A I platform for employees: a place to discover, create, share and run A I agents at work, with pre-built agents and applications. Agent Platform is for builders; Gemini Enterprise is for the workforce.

1.title: Pre-trained APIs and foundation models
1.text: Pre-trained A P Is and foundation models. Gemini (through the Agent Platform A P I). Multimodal foundation models: text, images, code, audio, video; chat, summarize, reason, create. Vision A P I. Understand images: labels, objects, text (O C R), faces. Cloud Translation A P I. Translate text between languages. Speech-to-Text A P I. Transcribe speech to text. Text-to-Speech. Turn text into natural speech. Natural Language A P I. Analyze text: sentiment, entities. Exam tip: Picture to Vision. Languages to Translation. Audio to words to Speech-to-Text. Open-ended generation or chat to Gemini.

1.title: AI Hypercomputer
1.text: A I Hypercomputer. A I Hypercomputer is Google Cloud's integrated supercomputing architecture to train, tune and serve A I. Purpose-built hardware. G P Us and Google's own Tensor Processing Units (T P Us), plus storage and networking built for A I. Open software. Industry-leading software and open standards (popular frameworks and tools). Flexible consumption. Cost control with options such as Dynamic Workload Scheduler and spot V Ms. Business benefit: better performance and efficiency and lower cost per A I workload.

1.title: BigQuery ML
1.text: Big Query M L. Big Query M L lets analysts create and run M L models inside Big Query with standard sequel, without moving data or writing Python, and experiment quickly. Exam tip: Big Query M L equals sequel users build M L models where the data already lives.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. A company wants to add translation to its app quickly, without M L expertise. Which solution fits best? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Cloud Translation A P I, a pre-trained A P I. A pre-trained A P I gives speed and low effort for a common task such as translation.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A retailer has labeled product images and limited M L expertise and wants a model for its own categories. Which approach fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is D: Auto M L, trained on its own data with little code. Auto M L trains a custom model on the company's own data with little code.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. A team of data scientists needs a unique model that gives a lasting competitive advantage. What should they consider? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: A custom model built on the Agent Platform. Custom models give the most differentiation and need the most expertise.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. Which statement best describes Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: An open, all-in-one platform to build, scale and govern A I agents. Agent Platform is the A I developer platform for building, scaling, governing and optimizing agents.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. A company wants employees to discover, create and run A I agents at work. Which offering is the best fit? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Gemini Enterprise, the A I platform for employees. Gemini Enterprise is the platform for employees to find, build and run agents.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. Analysts who only know sequel want to build a prediction model on data in Big Query. Which feature fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Big Query M L. Big Query M L builds and runs M L models with standard sequel inside Big Query.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. Which A P I understands images? Answer: The Vision A P I. Question two. What does Auto M L do? Answer: Trains custom models on your data with little code. Question three. What is Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform earlier known as? Answer: Vertex A I.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What are the parts of A I Hypercomputer? Answer: Purpose-built hardware, open software, flexible consumption. Question five. What does Big Query M L use to build models? Answer: Standard sequel. Question six. What is a T P U? Answer: Google's own chip built for machine learning.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Choosing: speed, effort, differentiation, expertise, choice; pre-trained, Auto M L, custom. Agent Platform: build, scale, govern agents; Model Garden, Agent Studio, Auto M L, M L Ops. Gemini Enterprise: A I platform for employees. A P Is: Vision (images), Translation, Speech-to-Text, Gemini (generation). A I Hypercomputer: G P Us and T P Us, open software, flexible consumption. Big Query M L: M L with sequel in the warehouse.
